title: Concept: Dart dependency declared as `any`
description: pubspec.yaml declares a pubspec dependency whose constraint is `any`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every release satisfies the constraint, so `pub get` follows whatever the hosted server publishes next.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pubspec.yaml (pub).
risk: Every release satisfies the constraint, so `pub get` follows whatever the hosted server publishes next.
